theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_fd_cone_integral_smul
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsConeCurrent C → R.Represents C → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ x, φ (r • x) ∂R.measure = (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ x, φ x ∂R.measure
